project_type: npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo: @mlb/shared (domain types + seed), @mlb/backend (Lambda handlers, MLB client, predict, Bedrock), @mlb/frontend (Vite React SPA), @mlb/infra (AWS CDK). Strict TS, ESM everywhere.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts orchestrate per-workspace builds in dependency order shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra. node v22.23.3 and npm are NOT on PATH by default; prefix commands with PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (npm lives next to node at /usr/local/bin/node too, but the nvm bin dir reliably provides npm).
test_framework: Vitest for unit + property tests (fast-check), colocated as *.test.ts / *.property.test.ts in each workspace. Playwright for frontend e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts.
test_command: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test  (runs vitest across all workspaces). e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (Playwright headless chromium; may need `npx playwright install chromium` once). synth: npm run synth.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build must stay green (ordered). 2) npm test must pass, including NEW unit tests asserting FIXED backtest numbers for 2024/2025 at a known accuracy, plus existing predict() tests unchanged. 3) npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend asserting the accuracy page renders hit rate / Brier / calibration + metric explanations in EN and/or JA. 4) npm run synth (cdk synth, no AWS). Do NOT run cdk deploy; no live Bedrock/MLB calls.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null (no committed snapshots). infra cdk.out is generated by synth but gitignored.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed at repo root (workspaces hoisted). If missing: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm install. For e2e, Playwright chromium may need: npx playwright install chromium (run once; needs network).
environment_constraints: Branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; stay on it with incremental commits. Do NOT push, open PRs, create/close issues, or deploy. No AWS calls. Chosen design is fully client-side + shared + docs: no infra/backend behavior change required. node/npm not on PATH by default.
contribution_requirements: .kiro/steering/*.md is inclusion:always: make incremental commits; keep specs truthful; spec-driven development is graded, so update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md AND both README.md and README.ja.md to describe the backtest feature and the Brier/calibration metric definitions. Domain types live only in @mlb/shared; never duplicate them. All three test layers (unit, property, e2e) must stay green.
key_patterns: predict(series, bracket, winPct, accuracy) is a PURE function currently at backend/src/predict/model.ts, importing ONLY from @mlb/shared. Favorite prob clamped to [0.5,0.95]; accuracy in [0,1] (default 0.5) is a sharpness factor f=2*accuracy applied around floor 0.5. Series winner in seed data = the team that reached clinch=ceil(bestOf/2) wins (equivalently the side with the greater of high.wins/low.wins at status 'final'). Seed brackets POSTSEASON_2024/2025 exported from @mlb/shared; each series has games[] with per-game winners and seriesGameNumber. i18n is a flat dotted-key dictionary in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (MessageKey union + MESSAGES[en|ja]); default lang is 'ja'. Routes in frontend/src/App.tsx use react-router path-based routing. accuracy slider bounds live in shared/src/accuracy.ts (MIN/MAX/DEFAULT/STEP).
relevant_files: backend/src/predict/model.ts (predict() source of truth; study + decide module boundary)
backend/src/predict/model.test.ts (existing predict tests that MUST stay green)
shared/src/index.ts (barrel; add backtest + predict exports here)
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx (pattern for a page; add a link to /accuracy)
directory_structure: shared/src: types.ts, season.ts, accuracy.ts, narrative.ts, integrity.ts, seed/{index.ts,postseason-2024.json,postseason-2025.json}, index.ts. backend/src: predict/{model.ts,standings.ts}, mlb/, bedrock/, service/, store/, index.ts. frontend/src: App.tsx, main.tsx, config.ts, pages/, components/, i18n/, test/. frontend/e2e: *.spec.ts. infra/src: CDK app.
